name: hardsigmoid_backward
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::hardsigmoid_backward(Tensor grad_output, Tensor self) -> Tensor. Computes the hard-sigmoid input gradient without mutating or aliasing grad_output or self. Tests cover deterministic floating inputs, legacy pointwise shapes, zero-sized and noncontiguous tensors, exact threshold neighborhoods around -3 and 3, infinities and NaN, output metadata, input non-mutation, and invalid nonbroadcastable shapes.
